title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
Intelligence Analyst with over 7 years of experience in intelligence analysis, data synthesis, and operational leadership. Possesses a TS//SCI Security Clearance with polygraph and extensive experience across OSINT, SIGINT, and HUMINT domains. Proven ability to identify trends, develop actionable insights, and support strategic decision-making in high-tempo environments. Passionate about applying analytical thinking and technology to strengthen mission success and organizational intelligence capabilities.




Boston University
Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics
Jan 2025 – Present
University of Maryland Global Campus
Bachelor’s Degree in Cybersecurity Management and Policy (Honors)
2021 – Dec 2024






U.S. Central Command (USCENTCOM), Tampa, FL
Mar 2025 – Present
- Conducts geopolitical analysis to support CENTCOM’s strategic planning.
- Drafts intelligence reports aligned with command priorities, improving operational decision-making.
- Collaborates with external entities to co-author intelligence products and promote interagency coordination.
- Supports partner engagement across the 5th Fleet Area of Responsibility (AOR), strengthening regional intelligence cooperation.




Norfolk, VA | Oct 2021 – Nov 2024
- Provided intelligence analysis for global patrol and reconnaissance missions.
- Delivered Flag-level intelligence briefings, enhancing operational awareness and readiness.
- Managed security clearances for 47 personnel and ensured compliance with TS/SCI standards.
- Co-created the MPRA Special Security Program for maintaining aircraft with TS/SCI classification.




Norfolk, VA | Jun 2018 – Jun 2021
- Led a 15-member team delivering daily intelligence briefs for C5F and C6F deployments.
- Produced over 1,000 intelligence products and 1,600 tactical reports supporting multi-fleet operations.
- Implemented advanced analytical techniques to improve threat assessments and operational planning.
- Recognized for outstanding leadership under high-stress operational conditions.




Norfolk, VA | Nov 2017 – Nov 2024
- Coordinated intelligence operations for four warships, enhancing situational awareness.
- Supported C7F assets in Japan, preparing mission briefs and assessments.
- Developed and trained junior analysts, improving team efficiency and readiness.
- Leveraged OSINT, HUMINT, and SIGINT tools (including Analyst Notebook and Palantir) to produce actionable intelligence.






Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal (3)

USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (Rear Adm. McLane)

USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (Capt. Campagna)

Patrol Squadron Sixteen (Cmdr. Radford)


Navy and Marine Corps Commendation Medal (Adm. Mietus)

Operational Deployments:

2020 – Fifth and Sixth Fleet, Operation Inherent Resolve

2021 – Fifth and Sixth Fleet, Operation Inherent Resolve

2023 – Seventh Fleet (Kadena, Japan), MPRA Support







Security Clearance: TS/SCI with Polygraph

Analytical Disciplines: OSINT, HUMINT, SIGINT

Technical Skills: Analyst Notebook, Palantir

Soft Skills: Critical Thinking, Leadership, Collaboration, Communication

Project Management: Strategic Planning, Data Analysis, Information Dissemination






Directed 120 specialists, enhancing tactical readiness and information flow.

Managed Special Security Program compliance for TS/SCI environments.

Co-developed protocols for new intelligence-gathering processes and training standards.

text: Experienced in machine learning, optimization modeling, and data visualization. Skilled in Python, SQL, and Quarto.

title: About Me
text:
About Me
